hospitalDetails.name: Banner Del E. Webb Medical Center
hospitalDetails.address: 14502 W Meeker Blvd, Sun City West, AZ 85375
hospitalDetails.distance: About 10 minutes west of central Peoria in Sun City West
hospitalDetails.doulaPolicy: Doulas are welcome as members of the support team; private labor/delivery/recovery rooms are set up to support a variety of birthing plans. Confirm current support-person rules at your maternity tour.
hospitalDetails.birthingFacilities: Complete maternity program with private LDR rooms, hydrotherapy tubs and nitrous oxide in every labor room, Level II Special Care Nursery with onsite neonatologists 24/7, certified nurse-midwife care, couplet care, skin-to-skin kangaroo care and a dedicated cesarean recovery area.
hospitalDetails.paragraph: Banner Del E. Webb is the workhorse maternity hospital for Peoria and the west valley, sitting at 14502 W Meeker Blvd about ten minutes from central Peoria. It carries the details that matter to laboring families: hydrotherapy tubs and nitrous oxide in all labor and delivery rooms, certified nurse-midwives on staff, a Level II Special Care Nursery with neonatologists onsite around the clock, and couplet care that keeps well babies in the room with their mothers. CMS lists it as a birthing-friendly hospital, and the walking-tour program runs out of the maternity front desk.

hospitalDetails.name: Abrazo Arrowhead Campus
hospitalDetails.distance: Just across the Loop 101 from northeast Peoria
hospitalDetails.doulaPolicy: Doulas welcome as support persons in labor; women's services staff coordinate visitor roles at check-in. Confirm the count of allowed support persons on your unit tour.
hospitalDetails.birthingFacilities: Full women's services program with labor and delivery suites, a mother-baby unit and breastfeeding support; the hospital anchors Abrazo's northwest-valley women's care.
hospitalDetails.paragraph: Abrazo Arrowhead Campus sits at 18701 N. 67th Ave, an exit-adjacent drive for anyone in east or north Peoria who takes the Loop 101. It has been a northwest-valley institution since 1988 and its women's services program delivers a large share of the area's babies - local coverage in the Peoria Times describes the labor-and-delivery floor's routine of celebrating new mothers. Families choosing between it and Banner Del E. Webb usually split on geography: Arrowhead wins for the east side of the city, Webb for the west.

birthCenterDetails.name: Canyon Midwifery birth center
birthCenterDetails.distance: Inside Peoria city limits, off N 83rd Ave
birthCenterDetails.credential: Freestanding birth center, accredited by the Commission for the Accreditation of Birth Centers (CABC) since March 2024
birthCenterDetails.paragraph: Canyon Midwifery is Peoria's own freestanding birth center, in Suite 300 at 13470 N 83rd Ave, and it earned CABC accreditation in March 2024 - the national gold standard for out-of-hospital birth safety and operations. Midwifery-led care here covers the full prenatal arc through birth and postpartum, with water birth available in the birth suites. For Peoria families wanting a low-intervention birth without a hospital commute, this is the in-city option, and the nearest hospital-transfer route runs the same short corridor as the local EMS network.
